content: Twent runs on Android 8.0+ and gives you a real AI assistant that can see your screen, control any app, run shell commands, browse the web, manage files, and connect to external tools — all from a floating bubble or the main chat interface. Download the APK and install Twent on your device. Configure your AI provider and start chatting. 40+ built-in tools — file system, shell, web, media, UI automation. Multi-step automations with triggers and conditions. Why Twent exists Most AI assistants live in a chat bubble and can't touch your device. Twent is different — it runs on your phone with full access to the OS, giving AI real agency: reading your screen, tapping buttons, running commands, and managing files. All data stays on your device. BYOK model — your keys, your data. Zero analytics SDKs, zero trackers, zero silent data collection. Verify with any network analysis tool. MCP servers, packages, skills, and workflows for infinite capability. What Twent can do The AI can see your screen via Accessibility service, tap buttons, fill forms, swipe, scroll, and type — automating any app without API access or special integrations. Built-in Ubuntu 24.04 terminal — no root required. Install packages with apt, run Python scripts, use Git, SSH to servers, and build software. Read, write, search, and edit files on your device. Run JavaScript/TypeScript code. Compress, decompress, and transfer files. Fetch web pages as markdown, search with DuckDuckGo/Bing/Scholar, download files, and use a built-in browser with JavaScript execution. Full FFmpeg engine, camera integration, OCR, image analysis, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech — all built in. Quick start Get the latest APK from twent.xyz. The APK is 80MB and includes everything you need. Open the APK, enable "Install from unknown sources" if prompted, then grant the requested permissions. Storage and Network are required; Accessibility enables UI automation. Go to Settings → Model & Parameters Configuration. Add your API key (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, or many more). Tap the floating bubble or open the chat screen. Ask Twent to do anything — run commands, automate apps, browse the web, or manage files. :::tip Twent is completely free. Paid model API usage is billed by your chosen provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.). If someone asks you to pay for Twent itself, it's a scam. ::: Next steps Full system requirements and download instructions. Configure providers, set API keys, and pick a model. Streaming, tool calls, conversation management, and more. Complete parameter reference for every built-in tool.
description: Twent is a personal AI agent for Android — automate any app, run a full Ubuntu terminal, and connect to 1000+ services. Free, local-first, and extensible.

content: App Name: Twent How to Delete Your Data Twent is a local-first application. We do not store your personal data, chat history, or agentic memory on our own servers. All your data is stored locally on your device. To delete your data, please follow these steps: Option 1 (In-App) Open the Twent app, navigate to Settings, and tap the "Clear All Local Data" button. Option 2 (Android System) Go to your Android device Settings Apps Twent Storage & cache tap Clear Storage (or Clear Data). What Data is Deleted Executing the steps above will permanently and immediately delete all locally stored data, including: Chat history and conversation logs. Agentic memory and knowledge base entries. Saved workflows, templates, and local configurations. What Data is Kept / Third-Party Data Because Twent operates on a Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) model, your prompts and files are sent directly to the third-party AI providers you choose (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic). Twent does not retain this data. Any data processed by these third-party providers is subject to their respective privacy policies and data retention practices.
description: App Name: **Twent**
title: Data Deletion Instructions
